title: Improving Certified Robustness via Adversarial Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2606.31653v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Certified training aims to produce models whose predictions can be formally verified against adversarial perturbations, typically by optimising upper bounds on the worst-case loss over an allowed perturbation set. For neural networks, certified training methods based purely on tight relaxation bounds produce networks that are amenable to certification, but sacrifice standard accuracy. Conversely, adversarial training often yields stronger empirical robustness and standard accuracy, but the resulting models are generally difficult to certify with neural network verifiers. Recently, the literature has shown that better standard-certified accuracy trade-offs can be achieved by combining adversarial training objectives with loose over-approximations based on Interval Bound Propagation (IBP), effectively interpolating between lower and upper bounds of the worst-case loss. translated_title: 通过对抗蒸馏提升认证鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 认证训练旨在产生预测结果能够针对对抗扰动进行形式化验证的模型，通常通过在允许的扰动集上优化最坏情况损失的上界来实现。对于神经网络而言，纯粹基于紧致松弛界的认证训练方法所产生的网络虽然易于认证，但会牺牲标准准确率。相反，对抗训练通常能带来更强的经验鲁棒性和标准准确率，但由此产生的模型通常难以用神经网络验证器进行认证。最近有研究表明，通过将对抗训练目标与基于区间界传播（IBP）的松散过近似相结合，可以实现更好的标准准确率与认证准确率之间的权衡，有效地在最坏情况损失的下界与上界之间进行插值。在此基础上，我们提出了AD-CERT，一种认证训练方法（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了结合对抗蒸馏的认证训练方法AD-CERT，通过将对抗训练目标与IBP松弛界相结合，在标准准确率与认证鲁棒性之间取得更好的权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AD-CERT, a certified training method that leverages adversarial distillation by combining adversarial training objectives with IBP-based relaxations to achieve better trade-offs between standard and certified accuracy.
